## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / code cleanup

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes:

- [ ] Unit tests (`python -m unittest tests.test_staging_app`)
- [ ] Manual test with physical hardware (Electro-Voice Dx38 / Dynacord DSP244)
- [ ] Manual test in Demo / Offline mode
- [ ] Syntax check (`python -m py_compile ...`)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or unhandled exceptions
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published
